text: The fix is straightforward. The original regex `[^a-z0-9]` replaced each non-alphanumeric character individually with a hyphen, causing consecutive hyphens. I changed it to `[^a-z0-9]+` to collapse consecutive non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen. I also added `.strip("-")` to remove any leading or trailing hyp

arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in `textkit/slug.py` by changing the regex from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` (collapsing consecutive non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen) and adding `.strip("-")` to remove leading/trailing hyphens. This resolves the double-hyphen and trailing-hyphen issues.
